d: Tamara is a leading fintech platform in Saudi Arabia and the GCC region with a mission to help people own their dreams built on being simple, trusted, and everywhere our customers need us. Today, more than 25 million customers and over 130,000 partner merchants depend on Tamara every day for reliable financial solutions across retail, travel, education, healthcare, and beyond. Tamara is backed by Sanabil Investments, a wholly owned company of the Public Investment Fund (PIF), and SNB Capital, among others.

As a Collection Specialist, you will be responsible for managing and recovering overdue payments from customers in the KSA market. The role requires strong communication skills, good at convincing, cultural awareness, and professionalism in handling customers across diverse nationalities.
r: Attempt 300-350 calls on a daily basis.
Contact customers via all available channels like call,WhatsApp, and email to remind them of outstanding payments.
Accurately document all customer interactions and update CRM systems in real-time.
Escalate unresolved or high-risk cases to the team lead or concerned departments.
Ensure all communications are compliant with SAMA collection guidelines and Tamara's internal policies.
Meet daily and monthly collection targets and maintain high customer satisfaction standards.
Can work as per the defined collection shifts starting as early as 8:00 AM KSA time.
Should be comfortable working in rotational shifts.
1–2 years of experience in debt collection, customer service, or telecalling roles.
Good understanding of collection tactics to convince the customer
Fluency in Arabic and English is mandatory; proficiency in any of these languages Is preferable Hindi, Urdu, or Filipino.
Strong convincing, persuasion, and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with CRM tools and dialer systems is preferred.
Understanding of MS Excel is strong plus
x: Opportunity to work with one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the region.
Modern workspace, training, and growth opportunities.
Exposure to multi-national customer interactions and regional collections best practices.

The Digital Marketing Executive plays a key role in strengthening the hotel's digital presence, driving online visibility and supporting commercial performance across all digital channels. Acting as a Brand Champion, this role is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, monitoring, and optimization of digital marketing initiatives, with a strong focus on driving direct bookings, enhancing digital conversion, and promoting the hotel's Rooms, F&B outlets, Spa and other revenue-generating experiences.

The Digital Marketing Executive will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing the hotel's digital platforms, ensuring that website content, offers, imagery, and information remain accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand standards. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Cluster Marketing Manager, Revenue Management, and internal stakeholders, this role will actively monitor digital performance, analyze key metrics, track campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve online visibility, traffic and conversion.

The role will also support the execution and performance monitoring of paid digital campaigns, including search, display and social media advertising, while ensuring alignment with the hotel's overall marketing and commercial objectives. The Digital Marketing Executive will work collaboratively with the Cluster Marketing Manager to develop digital assets, support campaign launches, and ensure consistent brand communication across online channels.

This individual should demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, commercial awareness, and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for digital growth. The ability to manage cluster priorities, interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations will be essential to the role.
Maintain and regularly update the hotel's website and digital platforms, ensuring accurate information, promotions, imagery and brand consistency.
Work closely with the Cluster Marketing Manager to support digital campaigns, website optimization and overall online performance.
Monitor the hotel's presence across third-party platforms, including OTAs, ensuring content, imagery and promotional information remain accurate and up to date.
Support the planning and execution of digital marketing campaigns to drive incremental Rooms and F&B ancillary revenue through paid search, social media advertising, and other online channels.
Track and report on key digital performance indicators, including website traffic, Digital Direct Share, conversion, campaign results, and return on advertising spend (ROAS).
Prepare monthly digital marketing performance reports, highlighting key results, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
Support the management of allocated digital marketing budgets, ensuring campaigns are monitored and spending remains aligned with approved plans.
Work closely with Revenue Management, Reservations and F&B, teams to ensure digital promotions and campaigns are aligned with business priorities and commercial objectives.

Manage day-to-day social media operations—including on-property photo and video capture, basic video editing, content calendar planning, copywriting, scheduling, community management, and coordinating influencer activations—to drive engagement and brand visibility across key platforms.
Manage CRM activities and execute targeted email marketing campaigns via third-party tools, working closely with hotel departments to drive guest engagement and repeat bookings.
Conduct basic market analysis and competitor monitoring to track digital activity, seasonal offers, and emerging trends across the competitive set.
Coordinate with Cluster Marketing Manager to ensure timely delivery of creative assets required for digital campaigns.
Assist in planning and launching digital promotions, packages, and seasonal campaigns across relevant online platforms.
Support the optimization of the hotel's online visibility, search engine presence, and direct booking opportunities.
Complete relevant administrative tasks, including campaign documentation, invoices, budget tracking, and coordination with external digital partners.
Stay informed about emerging digital marketing trends, platform updates, and opportunities to enhance the hotel's online presence.
Support the Cluster Marketing Manager with digital marketing initiatives and other related tasks as required.
q: Education: Diploma required; additional education in sales and marketing fields preferred.
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

d: At World Padel Academy (WPA), we’re looking for a proactive, personable, and organised Sales & Customer Service Executive to join our Oman team.

This role combines customer service, sales follow up, and front desk coordination. From helping a new player make their first booking to supporting a busy tournament, you’ll play an important part in keeping our club running smoothly and our customers coming back.
q: Excellent communication skills and a friendly, professional manner.
A proactive approach to sales follow-up and building customer relationships.
Confidence using booking and scheduling systems.
Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage several priorities in a busy club environment.
A dependable approach to company procedures and service standards.
If you enjoy working with people and take pride in delivering excellent service, we’d love to hear from you.
r: Create a welcoming experience: Greet players and visitors, answer enquiries, and provide helpful, professional service in person and over the phone.
Turn enquiries into bookings: Contact new marketing leads within 12 hours, understand their needs, and follow up consistently.
Manage bookings and registrations: Keep court reservations, event entries, and customer records accurate using Playtomic, Padelmates, or similar platforms.
Handle payments accurately: Process transactions in line with company procedures and flag outstanding payments to management.
Support our padel community: Help coordinate social sessions, leagues, tournaments, and events, including registrations and on-the-day assistance.
Work closely with the team: Coordinate with coaches, operations, and management to deliver a smooth customer experience.
Keep operations organised: Prepare daily occupancy reports, maintain enquiry records, and support administrative tasks while protecting confidential information.
